stopOrUndo: Stop once new recordings landing consistently where the test predicts without changing monitoring feel and no new problem is introduced. Undo or choose the alternative if using a global offset to hide monitoring or performance problems.
Restore the saved Project Alternative, duplicated track/comp, recording preference, routing, or monitoring state used as the baseline.

canonicalCards.recommendedFirstExperiment: Enable recording on only the intended track, verify the input meter, record a short test, and inspect the new region.
stopOrUndo: Stop once a new region appearing on the correct track with the expected source and no new problem is introduced. Undo or choose the alternative if assuming hearing a cue means the track is record-ready.
